disposition_reason: 168 EU-made multi-ingredient vitamin and mineral tablets from Polish pharmacies analyzed for cadmium, hexavalent chromium, nickel and lead; results are printed per single tablet dose, with cadmium and Cr(VI) not detected in any product.

study.design: Market survey of finished multi-ingredient food supplement tablets with simulated gastric (HCl) and intestinal (phosphate buffer) dissolution
study.origin: Produced in the European Union (countries not stated)
study.method: One tablet dissolved in 25 mL 100 mmol/L HCl, extract mineralized with HNO3; MIP-OES with flame AAS reference; Cr(VI) by diphenylcarbazide spectrophotometry
study.qa: BCR667, NIST2709 and IAEA405 reference materials (recoveries not printed)

findings.material_label: Multi-ingredient vitamin and mineral food supplement tablet (food supplements)
findings.reported: None of the analyzed FS had detectable levels of Cd
findings.notes: LOD not stated; measured in HCl extract after HNO3 mineralization.

findings.material_label: Multi-ingredient vitamin and mineral food supplement tablet (food supplements)
findings.reported: None of the analyzed FS had detectable levels of ... Cr(VI)
findings.notes: Diphenylcarbazide colorimetry at 540 nm; LOD not stated.

findings.material_label: Multi-ingredient vitamin and mineral food supplement tablet (food supplements)
findings.notes: Per tablet, not a concentration; value_ugkg null. Daily single dose equals 30.6% of the nickel tolerable intake for a 70 kg adult. 151 other products had no detectable nickel (LOD not stated).

findings.material_label: Multi-ingredient vitamin and mineral food supplement tablet (food supplements)
findings.notes: Per tablet, not a concentration; value_ugkg null. All 11 exceeded the EU 3.0 mg/kg maximum level, two by 11.1-fold and 16.9-fold; per-product values are figure-only (Fig. 3). 157 products had no detectable lead (LOD not stated).

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU maximum levels for food supplements (Regulation (EC) 629/2008)
Single daily dose share of tolerable intakes for detecting products
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Ni 30.6% of TDI, Pb 28% of PTWI (70 kg adult)

unresolved: Lead and nickel results are per tablet (mg/single unit dose); tablet masses are not printed, so per-kg concentrations cannot be stated. Individual lead values relative to 3.0 mg/kg are figure-only (Fig. 3).
Toxic elements were measured in the HCl extract (gastric simulation), so results may understate total content (mean solubility 63%).
LODs and CRM recoveries not printed; purchase dates not reported.
Group-level (nutrition, pregnancy, weight loss, neurological, cosmetic) element values are figure-only (Fig. 1-2).
